== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター：レベル４軍用通路</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-286o-PSA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side:''' <span lang="ja">ここを支配したなら、フォース消耗を＋１できる。</span>

'''Dark Side:''' <span lang="ja">自分の移動フェイズで、帝国軍はここから任意のデス・スターの位置へ移動コスト無しで移動できる。</span><ref name="jp-face" />

== Lore ==
No lore is printed on this card.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title:''' Death Star: Level 4 Military Corridor.

'''Light Side:''' If you control here, you may add 1 to the Force drain.

'''Dark Side:''' During your move phase, Imperials may move from here to any Death Star location at no movement cost.

* '''Uniqueness:''' Unique (one marker)
